title: Online BCA in Game Programming | UGC Entitled Online Degree
description: Turn your passion for gaming into a career. Pursue an online BCA in Game Programming at DSU Online. Learn Unity, Unreal Engine, AR/VR & game design. NAAC A+.

blocks.x: Design, program, and animate interactive digital games using logic, creativity, and modern game engines | Unity/Unreal basics | Visual scripting | Rendering & animation

This elective teaches you to combine logic, creativity, and technology to develop interactive digital games. You will learn to: - Implement game logic, rendering, and animation - Use visual scripting and basic game engine workflows (Unity & Unreal) - Design engaging gameplay mechanics and interactive experiences This program encourages creative problem-solving, coding proficiency, and opens opportunities in gaming, AR/VR, and indie game publishing.
Learn to structure game rules, mechanics, and interactive experiences using logical thinking and creative design approaches.
Implement animations, visual effects, and 2D/3D rendering techniques to create immersive game environments.
Gain hands-on experience with Unity and Unreal Engine basics, using visual scripting to develop gameplay functionality without code.
Write game code, integrate user input, control game physics, and implement interactive features to bring games to life.
Develop, test, and publish playable games, prototypes, or indie projects, preparing you for real-world gaming opportunities.
Develop basic gameplay features, write scripts, and assist in game development projects using Unity or Unreal Engine.
Design game mechanics, create level layouts, and collaborate with developers to implement interactive gameplay experiences.
Conceptualize, develop, and publish independent games, focusing on creativity, coding, and immersive user experiences.
Create 2D/3D animations, visual effects, and character movements to enhance the gaming experience.
Write and optimize code for gameplay mechanics, user interaction, and performance across different platforms.
Design immersive augmented and virtual reality experiences, integrating interactive elements and responsive gameplay.
